question: Who is incapable of knowing this secret that eludes even gods and gandharvas?
premises: It is not known by gods and gandharvas.
Earth-born beings are even less capable.
The argument proceeds from higher to lower beings.
inference: If gods and gandharvas do not know it, earth-born beings certainly do not.
plain_english: It is not known by gods and gandharvas; how much less by those born on earth.
